facts.fact: The page states that traditional marketing automation executes workflows based on predefined "if-then" rules, while AI-powered automation adds an intelligent layer to every stage of a campaign.
facts.quote: While traditional marketing automation executes workflows based on predefined "if-then" rules, AI-powered automation adds an intelligent layer to every stage of a campaign.

facts.fact: The page states that AI enables one-to-one personalization by analyzing customer data, preferences, and behavior.
facts.quote: AI enables true one-to-one personalization by analyzing customer data, preferences, and behavior.

facts.fact: The page recommends removing duplicate records, updating outdated information, and bringing together data from sources such as CRM, website, and campaigns before implementing AI in marketing automation.
facts.quote: This means removing duplicate records, updating outdated information, and bringing together data from different sources, like your CRM, website, and campaigns.
